posts.body:
TALAY & TALAY BEACH — COLLECTION UPDATE
Aldar | Marsa Al Saadiyat, Abu Dhabi

An 18 September sales briefing clarifies the previously announced 351-villa release:
• Talay: 167 villas; indicated handover Q4 2029.
• Talay Beach: 184 villas; indicated handover Q4 2030.
Both offer 4–6 bedroom standalone villas. These collection details remain sales-briefing/broker intelligence.

Aldar confirms sales open on 23 September 2026.
Talay is indicated from AED 13.5m with 50/50 payments; final developer terms are not independently verified. Talay Beach pricing remains unconfirmed. Verified booking/EOI amount not found.

Why it matters: different delivery targets when selecting a collection.
Confidence: high on the official sales date; medium on collection-specific details and terms.
